summary: Both halves inspected and the cancelled character after Sym enlarged. The proposed spherical functor is explicitly hypothetical. The source writes plural co-semisimplicial algebras, and the flat augmented symmetric-algebra presentation identifies indecomposables with M^n. The insertion (reduced) and the co- prefix are typed. Let’s has a readable corrected e over a doubtful older letter. The old an before L_* is readable. The glyph cancelled after Sym is too black to identify as the draft star. The handwritten word cancelled above the second member remains illegible. The last sentence names an arbitrary module L while formula(6) uses M; this literal mismatch remains.
